command:
set -e; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); python3 -m py_compile tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm.py tools/run_research_distillery.py tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py tools/run_research_distillery_local.py tools/run_free_evidence_forge.py tools/free_swarm_quota.py; bash -n tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm_supervisor.sh tools/local_research_model_server.sh; python3 - <<'PY'
import os,signal
me=os.getpid(); parent=os.getppid()
targets=('tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm.py','tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm_supervisor.sh','tools/run_research_distillery_local.py','tools/run_research_distillery_entry.py','tools/run_free_evidence_forge.py')
for n in os.listdir('/proc'):
 if not n.isdigit() or int(n) in (me,parent): continue
 try: args=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in open('/proc/'+n+'/cmdline','rb').read().split(b'\0') if x]
 except Exception: continue
 if not args: continue
 joined=' '.join(args[:4])
 if any(any(a.endswith(t) for a in args[:4]) for t in targets):
  try: os.kill(int(n),signal.SIGTERM); print('KILLED',n,joined[:180])
  except ProcessLookupError: pass
PY
sleep 2; nohup bash tools/run_24h_entityos_swarm_supervisor.sh >/artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/supervisor-v8.log 2>&1 </dev/null & echo SUP_PID=$!; sleep 45; echo ---PS---; ps -eo pid,etime,%cpu,%mem,args | grep -E '[r]un_24h_entityos_swarm|[r]un_research_distillery|[r]un_free_evidence_forge|[l]lama-server|[l]ocal_research_model_server|[f]ree swarm/evaluate.py' | head -40; echo ---SUP---; cat /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/SUPERVISOR.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo ---LOCALMODELLOG---; tail -30 /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/local-model-bootstrap.log 2>/dev/null || true; echo ---FORGE---; cat /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/forge/STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || true; echo ---DIST---; cat /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm/distillery/STATUS.json 2>/dev/null || true
